script_text: The stars are forcing Aries into their biggest decision of the year this week. Saturn at 5° Aries sits in your 1st House, squaring Mercury in Gemini, pressuring career communication early week. Monday is especially heavy when the Moon in Capricorn squares your natal Mars in the 1st House, tightening self-expression. Wednesday marks the turning point as Jupiter enters your 10th House of career, trining the Moon in a rare expansion opening professional doors. Thursday through Sunday, Venus moves through your 7th House of partnership, sextile to natal Pluto, igniting deep relationship transformation — love demands honesty this weekend. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter enters your 10th House. Monday is your worst day because Saturn squares Mercury in your 3rd House, blocking clarity. With Saturn disciplining your fire-driven 1st House, take one strategic and patient action step right now. Follow for daily updates.
